# Drizzle

[![Drizzle and other party guests — Hasbro Studios / DHX Media, cropped show-still collage](https://cdn.twibooru.org/img/2020/7/9/14509/full.png)](https://twibooru.org/14509)

Drizzle is the lavender-and-gold umbrella pony who briefly speaks up when Twilight's spare Gala ticket becomes public knowledge. She is a minor character in the G4 *Friendship Is Magic* television continuity, not merely a fan-created pony.

- **Appearance:** Pale lavender coat, golden-amber mane and tail, pale pinkish-purple eyes, and three purple umbrellas as her cutie mark. She shares the basic design of Parasol and Prim Posy. See the [Pegasus directory](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Pegasus_ponies) and [cutie-mark index](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_cutie_marks).
- **Naming:** Drizzle is an established fandom identification; no on-screen naming, original naming event, or official merchandise name was verified. No alternate identity is established.
- **Voice:** Tabitha St. Germain is listed for Drizzle in the [episode cast listing](https://www.imdb.com/title/tt1758315/fullcredits/). She has a brief speaking role rather than being entirely silent; the specific name-to-voice attribution is secondary-source evidence.
- **Appearances:** The Pegasus directory records her in S1E2. She speaks in S1E3 and appears at the Grand Galloping Gala in S1E26, where the [Earth pony directory](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies) also records her wingless model. This is a model variation, not an established transformation.

## Important moments

- **The question that gives away the ticket — The Ticket Master (S1E3).** After Pinkie's surprise party, Drizzle asks, “Wait, what ticket? What gala?” Pinkie's answer alerts the crowd, escalating Twilight's predicament. [Episode transcript](https://animatedshows.fandom.com/wiki/The_Ticket_Master/Transcript); [episode listing](https://tv.apple.com/us/episode/the-ticket-master/umc.cmc.2rg4xf8e1msco84hryprlwh92?showId=umc.cmc.3ujevsytv3nqn8uolyrrgws8j) (timestamp unavailable).
- **At the Gala at last — The Best Night Ever (S1E26).** Drizzle is identified among the guests at the very event she asked about earlier; this is a visual callback, not a separate character arc. [Episode listing](https://tv.apple.com/us/episode/the-best-night-ever/umc.cmc.2sahiw6grves1gqiglrt3xfhf?showId=umc.cmc.3ujevsytv3nqn8uolyrrgws8j) (timestamp unavailable).
